''See also: [[Caela Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Caela is a figure often associated with the color blue, frequently seen wearing a blue bonnet. She possesses a voice that can shift like the wind and has been known to communicate through sent messages. Physically, she is described as having wooden hands and has been observed resting on various objects, including crates of miscellaneous items or being positioned on a person's belt. She acts as a guide and source of wisdom for [[Simon]], offering him direction, instructions on how to fight, and information regarding the [[Dragon Army]] and [[Travelers]] of [[Valinhall]]. While she can be smug, self-satisfied, or even exasperated, she also demonstrates a protective nature, urging others to fight for innocent people and promising to keep certain individuals alive. She maintains a close connection to [[Kai]], at one point resting near his body.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Caela is a doll with short, curly blond hair and wooden hands. She wears a blue bonnet and a matching powder-blue dress, though her face features a painted wooden frown despite an expression of peace.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|As an advisor to [[Simon]], she provides guidance and tactical directions. She is known to respond with sarcasm or jokes and communicates with [[Simon]] through a mental voice.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Caela is cared for by [[Kai]], to whom she provides tactical directions during combat. She serves as an advisor and companion to [[Simon]], replacing [[Otoku]] in that role. Additionally, [[Leah]] has been seen holding the doll.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Caela is a talking doll who can communicate via a mental voice and has the ability to return to [[the House]]. She wields a [[Dragon's Fang|Dragon’s Fang]] and claims to hear the voice of the wind and speak the words of the air.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|Advisor to Simon}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|Caela serves as an advisor to [[Simon]], taking over the position previously held by [[Otoku]].<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c21">''House of Blades'', chapter 21</ref> Located on [[Simon]]'s belt, she maintains the ability to communicate with him and can return to [[the House]].<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c22">''House of Blades'', chapter 22</ref> After informing [[Simon]] that he had killed an Overlord, she advises him to make his way toward the [[Travelers]] situated atop the canyon.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c22" />}}
